🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive; the strong aggregate breadth contrasts with Technology’s weakness, while risk and cycle signals are unavailable. Leadership: Narrow-to-mixed (3 sectors represented in the Top 5); style mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Discretionary leads: GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) and RCL (1W: +11.10% | 1M: +13.77%), both ABOVE TREND. Healthcare follows with LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) and GILD (1W: +9.38% | 1M: +15.72%), both ABOVE TREND; Materials is also strong, with PPG (1W: +8.06% | 1M: +14.19%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology is weakest: GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%) and INTC (1W: -24.38% | 1M: -45.20%) are BELOW TREND. Communication is nearly flat for the week and negative for the month; TMUS (1W: +6.76% | 1M: -3.27%) is in RECOVERY, while TTWO (1W: -6.64% | 1M: -6.61%) is BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%), LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%), RCL (1W: +11.10% | 1M: +13.77%), GILD (1W: +9.38% | 1M: +15.72%), and PPG (1W: +8.06% | 1M: +14.19%) are all ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow-to-mixed (3 sectors represented); no single style leadership is confirmed.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NOW (1W: -33.87% | 1M: -23.69%), INTC (1W: -24.38% | 1M: -45.20%), GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%), CAT (1W: -9.14% | 1M: -24.46%), and BA (1W: -8.92% | 1M: -10.78%) are all BELOW TREND. Weakness is concentrated in Technology, with additional pressure in Industrials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%), LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%), and RCL (1W: +11.10% | 1M: +13.77%), all ABOVE TREND. TMUS (1W: +6.76% | 1M: -3.27%) is in RECOVERY; AAPL (1W: -0.89% | 1M: +4.33%) and MSFT (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +1.78%) are in CORRECTION.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is weak, with a sector return of -4.05% for the week and -6.51% for the month; individual positive-stock breadth was not provided. NVDA (1W: -3.00% | 1M: -11.36%), GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%), and META (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -15.28%) are BELOW TREND; AAPL (1W: -0.89% | 1M: +4.33%) and MSFT (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +1.78%) are in CORRECTION.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials gained 0.96% for the week and 4.15% for the month; positive-stock breadth within the sector was not provided. JPM (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +1.66%), V (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +14.93%), and MA (1W: +2.31% | 1M: +16.18%) are ABOVE TREND.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is leading, up 2.26% for the week and 10.22% for the month; individual positive-stock breadth was not provided. LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%), GILD (1W: +9.38% | 1M: +15.72%), JNJ (1W: +3.56% | 1M: +5.62%), and PFE (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +8.53%) are ABOVE TREND; UNH (1W: -2.66% | 1M: +11.44%) is in CORRECTION.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to stronger names such as GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%), LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%), and MA (1W: +2.31% | 1M: +16.18%), all ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to persistent Technology laggards such as GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%) and INTC (1W: -24.38% | 1M: -45.20%), both BELOW TREND. Style mixed / no clear leadership; broad sector breadth is offset by concentrated Technology weakness.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) and LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%), both ABOVE TREND; monitor for continuation after strong runs. BEARISH: INTC (1W: -24.38% | 1M: -45.20%) and NOW (1W: -33.87% | 1M: -23.69%), both BELOW TREND; watch for stabilization before treating the declines as exhausted.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare (+2.26% 1W; +10.22% 1M) and Materials (+2.88% 1W; +9.05% 1M), both with positive sector-level returns across the week and month. BEARISH: Technology (-4.05% 1W; -6.51% 1M); Communication is also fragile, up just 0.04% for the week and down 1.22% for the month.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Absolute price levels are not available in the supplied data; use return-based triggers instead. NVDA (1W: -3.00% | 1M: -11.36%) and GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%) need weekly stabilization to interrupt BELOW TREND; GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) and LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) would confirm continuation by holding ABOVE TREND.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
GD (+75): Q3 earnings lifted guidance and backlog reached a record; GD (1W: +6.65% | 1M: +12.53%) is ABOVE TREND, confirming the positive catalyst. CRH (+70): earnings update highlighted resilient growth and a buyback; CRH (1W: +6.97% | 1M: +11.15%) is ABOVE TREND, also confirming. AMZN (+50): analyst upgrade; AMZN (1W: -3.08% | 1M: -3.17%) is BELOW TREND, a sentiment-price divergence to monitor.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
BA (-50): price-target reduction; BA (1W: -8.92% | 1M: -10.78%) is BELOW TREND, confirming weakness. CAT (-45): price-target reduction; CAT (1W: -9.14% | 1M: -24.46%) is BELOW TREND, also confirming. META (-45): negative outlook tied to AI spending; META (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -15.28%) is BELOW TREND, in line with the sentiment.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, with 10/11 sectors positive but Technology weak; style mixed / no clear leadership, and Top 5 leadership is concentrated across 3 sectors. GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) and LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) are showing relative strength, both ABOVE TREND. Monitor the broad-versus-Tech divergence and AMZN (1W: -3.08% | 1M: -3.17%), where positive news sentiment diverges from BELOW TREND price action.
